column1: # Xylarium's elements: 150 rows, measured (Z 1-99, the standard references)
# and as the periodic law predicts them past that (Z 100-150).
# Columns (tab-separated; "-" where a value does not exist or is not measured):
#   z      atomic number
#   sym    symbol (IUPAC; systematic symbols past 118)
#   name   name (a game name in the alias column where xylarium trades it)
#   a      standard atomic weight, or the mass number of the longest-lived or
#          island-of-stability nuclide; "-" = the valley of beta stability (derived)
#   melt   melting point, K (at 1 bar; sublimation where it does not melt)
#   boil   boiling point, K (sublimation point where it does not boil at 1 bar)
#   rho    density of the condensed element, g/cm3 (liquid for gases)
#   abund  solar-system abundance, atoms per 10^6 Si (Lodders 2003; 0 = none
#          survives: short-lived)
#   tc     50% condensation temperature in a solar-composition gas, K (Lodders 2003)
#   class  Goldschmidt class: litho, sidero, chalco, atmo
#   origin nucleosynthetic channels and their shares: bb (Big Bang), spall
#          (cosmic-ray spallation), ccsn (core-collapse supernovae), ia (type Ia),
#          agb (AGB stars, the s-process), merger (neutron-star mergers, the
#          r-process); "-" = none survives from any
#   status measured | predicted (predicted rows take melt, boil, rho, tc and
#          class from their homologue by the periodic law)
#   homol  homologue for predicted rows ("-" for measured)
#   alias  xylarium's trade name ("-" for none)
# The measured rows are the standard references (CRC Handbook; Lodders
# 2003). Island-of-stability
# nuclides (114, 118, 120, 122, 126) are long-lived in this universe and made
# by neutron-star mergers; every other element past uranium decays away.
#z
